summary: AI photorealistic image generation from text prompts via the OpenAI image generation API: accepts a prompt and optional count parameter, returns PNG bytes. Available as an HTTP microservice on port 8003 or as a CLI command. Used in the main generation pipeline for producing photorealistic math context images to accompany SAT questions.

evidence.claim: POST /generate accepts a GenerateJsonRequest with prompt and n parameters and returns PNG bytes via OpenAI
GET /health returns a HealthResponse JSON for liveness probing of the image-gen microservice
image-gen generate CLI generates a PNG from a text prompt via OpenAI and writes to a file or stdout
image-gen serve CLI starts the FastAPI web server on port 8003 for POST /generate image requests
The image-gen component uses the OpenAI image generation API as its sole AI provider

invariants.statement: Image generation uses the OpenAI API exclusively, not a self-hosted model
The microservice runs on port 8003 by default
POST /generate returns image/png bytes directly, not a JSON wrapper

scenarios.name: generate image via HTTP
scenarios.given: A JSON body with a prompt string and optional n count
scenarios.then: PNG bytes are returned with image/png content-type

scenarios.name: generate image via CLI
scenarios.given: A text prompt passed as a CLI argument
scenarios.then: A PNG file is written to the specified output path or stdout

rebuild_decisions.name: Image generation provider
options: Google Imagen or Stable Diffusion for provider independence
rebuild_decisions.constraints_from_source: OpenAI is the only configured integration
